messages:
emma_marketing: Quick sync — aiming to finalize copy + routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages today. Agenda: hero CTA + subhead, benchmark callout for launch post, webinar hook & signup flow, inbound lead routing. Can we do a quick pass?

aj: I'm in. For benchmarks we should call out latency and per-token cost wins vs managed endpoints. I have infra numbers we can use.

sasha: I can draft the benchmark blurb: 'Up to 3x higher throughput and 25–35% lower per-token cost with Redwood's batching + KV cache.' Need exact percentages to lock.

luke: For routing: prefer form -> product tag -> queue mapping. Draft mapping below, open to tweaks:
```
if product == \"Private\": route = \"AE-enterprise\"
elif product == \"Dedicated\": route = \"SDR-dedicated\"
else: route = \"Inbound-hosted\"
```

maria: Hero CTA options to A/B: 1) "Start free with Hosted" 2) "Reserve Dedicated capacity" 3) "Request a private deployment" — we should keep subhead consistent: short benefit + trust signal.

beth_prod: Product check: For Dedicated copy please include 'predictable throughput' and 'SLA-backed latency targets' — ok to use 'SLA-backed'?

emma_marketing: Yes, use SLA-backed. Also want a concise benchmark card for the launch post: short stat + one-line context. Example: '30% lower per-token cost vs baseline on common instruction workloads.'

aj: I'll author the benchmark card once david-infra confirms the baseline numbers.

david-infra: Confirming preliminary numbers — typical instruct workload measured across our test suite shows ~28–35% cost improvement with batching + caching. Median p95 latency on Dedicated profile ~42ms. Use ranges in copy.

sasha: Webinar idea: 'Reducing inference costs: production patterns from real customers' — I'll host and cover batching, caching, and routing. Suggested date: May 12. Landing link: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar-costs

emma_marketing: Perfect. Webinar CTA on each page should be secondary but prominent for mid-funnel: 'Watch: How we cut inference costs' with /webinar link. Primary CTA stays product-specific.

luke: I'll implement form hidden fields: product_choice, expected_tokens_per_month, company_size — that should make routing rules more reliable. Also will hook form to the queue mapping above.

deploy-bot: Staging preview published: https://staging.redwood.ai/landing/ux-pass :rocket: (includes Hosted / Dedicated / Private variants)

emma_marketing: Action items: 1) @sasha — draft webinar landing & slides; 2) @aj — benchmark card copy; 3) @beth_prod — confirm Dedicated wording; 4) @luke — implement form + routing; 5) @david-infra — finalize numbers. Check back by EOD and we ship the launch post + page changes tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sasha: Got it, I'll post initial deck by EOD and add speaker notes.

aj: I'll draft the benchmark card and short tweet-length pull for launch post.

beth_prod: I'll review Dedicated copy and confirm wording by 4pm.

luke: Routing + hidden fields pushed to staging, will validate webhooks and give a thumbs up once tested.

david-infra: I'll drop a short csv with the raw numbers in #eng-ml later today.

emma_marketing: Thanks team — small follow-up sync at 3:30 if anyone needs to jump in. If not, we'll reconvene in thread.
